map.由焦距与有效孔径，按 N = f/D 计算摄影镜头光圈数。: From the focal length and effective aperture, compute the photographic lens f-number using N = f/D.
map.N 每增大 √2 倍，进光量减半；景深随 N 增大而增大。: Each √2 increase in N halves the light intake; depth of field increases as N grows.
map.由焦距与口径算 F 数（F=f/D）。: From the focal length and aperture, compute the F-number (F=f/D).
map.F 数决定进光量与景深。: The F-number determines light intake and depth of field.
map.焦距 50mm、口径 25mm → F=50/25=2.0（F2 大光圈）；口径: Focal length 50mm, aperture 25mm → F=50/25=2.0 (F2 fast aperture); aperture 12.5mm → F=4.0.
map.F2→F4 口径减半、进光量降 1/4（差 2 档）；F 数每×√2 进光减半，: F2→F4 halves the aperture and reduces the light to 1/4 (a 2-stop difference); each √2 increase in F-number halves the light, and depth of field deepens accordingly.
map.F 数小光圈大？: Does a small F-number mean a large aperture?
map.对。F=f/D，D 大则 F 小、进光多、景深浅，背景虚化强。: Yes. F=f/D, so a large D gives a small F, more light intake, shallow depth of field and strong background blur.
map.F 数大（小口径）景深深、前后都清；F 数小景深浅、虚化强。: A large F-number (small aperture) gives deep depth of field with both foreground and background sharp; a small F-number gives shallow depth of field and strong blur.
